name: Object Editor
description: Table editor for unit, item, ability, buff, doodad, destructable and upgrade data.

mcpTools.name: set_object_fields
mcpTools.description: Changes fields of an object in the object data of the map, as one edit. Find fields with get_object and gameValues. All of them are checked first: if one is wrong, none changes. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools; undo_last_edit takes it back.

value.description: The new value. null takes it back to the game's.

mcpTools.name: create_object
mcpTools.description: Adds a custom object based on a game object. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools; undo_last_edit takes it back.

base.description: The game object to start from, like hfoo.

mcpTools.name: delete_object
mcpTools.description: Removes a custom object, or what the map changes in a game object. Anything placed or using it stays and must be fixed too. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools; undo_last_edit takes it back.

mcpTools.name: list_objects
mcpTools.description: Object data of the open map: the objects it adds or changes, or with scope "game" the game's own. Gives ids for get_object. Game objects say when they have no model, or one only in some graphics modes (they'd be invisible otherwise), their size range, and whether they take up ground.

scope.description: map (default): what the map adds or changes. game: everything in the game.

filter.description: Only ids or names containing this text (not case sensitive). Game names are in the installed language.

tileset.description: scope game, doodads and destructables: only those made for this tileset. "map" means the open map's, or give its letter.

category.description: scope game: only this category, as the entries show it (not case sensitive).

trees.description: scope game, destructables: only real trees, as the game targets them.

mcpTools.name: get_object
mcpTools.description: One object: what the map changes in it, with field names, and with gameValues its values as the game defines them.

id.description: Four letters, like hfoo or h000.

gameValues.description: Also list every field's value from the game (long).

services.description: Object browser over game and custom objects (pick).
